home.detectDesc: Multi-index fusion detection based on TruFor (CVPR 2023) · V2.4
home.detectDetail: Based on the TruFor (CVPR 2023) feature consistency detection network, integrating noiseprint, RGB tampering probability, tampering level, and local confidence for comprehensive judgment (Yes / Suspected / No); one-click export of detection area ratio, peak value, confidence, etc. to Excel.
home.verifyDesc: SuperPoint + LightGlue scene verification · Pairing / Batch / Export
home.verifyDetail: Upload rectification and inspection images, automatically pair by filename UUID+number (or sequential/single-point mode). Features: SuperPoint keypoint extraction → LightGlue matching → RANSAC geometric verification (Fundamental/Homography) to determine if two images depict the same scene. Results can be manually corrected and exported to Excel.
home.faceDesc: RetinaFace + ArcFace · Photo recognition / Manual enrollment / Excel export
home.faceDetail: Upload photos for batch recognition (group photos supported, multiple faces detected): RetinaFace detects and crops each face → ArcFace extracts 512-d features → 1:N retrieval against the global face library. Failed matches can be manually named and enrolled (auto duplicate check with confirm for overwrite or new person); supports retest, manual correction, detail view (Top-K candidates + 512-d features) and Excel export.
home.rsDesc: Multimodal LLM · New construction detect / rectification verify / violation classify
home.rsDetail: Remote sensing verification powered by multimodal LLMs (cloud API or local Ollama models): compare two images to detect new constructions (old → new) or verify rectification removal (pre- → post-rectification), and single-image classification of four violations (illegal occupation / mining / dumping / construction). Supports batch verification and re-verification, with annotated comparison images exportable to Excel.
